### Review Summary
The PR successfully applies the new Opencode `v1.14.x` permission schema across all 24 agents, converting the older array-based `allow`/`deny` lists to the enforced object-map format. System-wide configuration updates, including the `default_agent` mapping, task ID mapping for the 7 dispatch agents, and comprehensive documentation revisions, are accurately implemented without functional regressions.

#### Suggestions

[S-01] Inconsistent YAML spacing
Category: Style
Severity: Suggestion
File: .opencode/agents/orchestrator-v3.md
Lines: 8-41
Description: The `bash` and `task` permission keys use 8 spaces of indentation inside the `permission` block. While this is valid YAML, it diverges organically from the standard 4-space indentation present in the frontmatter of other agent definitions (e.g. `planner.md`).
Suggestion: Reformat the updated `bash` and `task` blocks to use 4 spaces (2 relative to their parent key) for consistency.

```yaml
  bash:
    "*": "deny"
    "pytest*": "allow"
```

### Overall Assessment
The code is ready for merge. The object-map conversion adheres tightly to the migration requirements and `v1.14.x` standards with correctly scoped capability strings and strict boolean bindings for `tools:`. Model-specific variants are fully synchronised and all task mappings accurately match agent file IDs now. Other than an isolated indentation style inconsistency in `orchestrator-v3.md`, there are absolutely no correctness, stability, security, or structural concerns natively preventing an immediate integration.
